principle: one authoritative DSP graph attached to the single Media3 playback path; no second player state machine; observation never modifies playback

nodes.note: no EQ/compression/spatialization/split-band or aesthetic parameters exist in 69

headroom_semantics: sample-peak threshold; identity graph never exceeds input, hot fixture (> -1 dBFS) deterministically trips protection; documented as sample-peak approximation, NOT oversampled true-peak
offload_evidence: processor installed via DefaultAudioSink.Builder.setAudioProcessors; offload callback observed as UNKNOWN on this device (no offload signal with processor active); mutual-exclusion relationship recorded, never claimed both active

bypass_semantics.explicit: DspGraphRuntime.requestBypass(reason) -> processor reports inactive at next reconfigure; Media3 skips it (clean path)
bypass_semantics.automatic: headroom limit trip OR unsupported format -> requestBypass with recorded reason
bypass_semantics.playback_continuity: queueInput always passes data through even after bypass request; bypass takes effect only at reconfigure, never mid-stream (fix: input.position must advance, Media3 re-sends otherwise)

unsupported_handling: UnhandledAudioFormatException -> Media3 drops processor from chain; playback continues on direct path
latency_reporting: identity latency = 0ms (constant, no buffering); pipeline measures actual processing cost separately in runtime_benchmarks.json
honesty_rules: null = not observed; no inference presented as measured fact
UNKNOWN = no signal received during observation window
truePeakDb is sample-peak approximation (not oversampled); stated in every artifact
no claim of post-mixer bit-perfection (boundary from MFY_ANDROID_AUDIO_PATH_OBSERVABILITY_001)
